What Lasso Is All About

Infinity & Beyond

Innovation never stops, we’re always one step ahead. Lasso committed to leading the way in GenAI security, and pushing boundaries to create innovative solutions.

Communication & Trust

We encourage openness in communication, transparency in decision-making processes, and trust between all team members.

Celebrate Everyone

Each of us adds a special twist to our journey, making our adventure fun and unique!

Make an Impact

We’re here to do good—for our customers, team, and the world. At Lasso, your voice matters, your ideas shine,  and growth is encouraged.

Lasso is the AI Security Platform built for the agentic era. By connecting discovery, AI risk management, automated red teaming, and runtime protection in a single continuous loop, Lasso ensures every agentic application behaves within its intended scope, at every stage of its lifecycle.
